en.title: Three questions before the story
en.subtitle: A familiar shape is a starting point for a question
items: What is it made from, and how was it made?
Is there a signature, stamp or maker’s label?
When was this object made—not just the scene it depicts?
en.caption: A short looking guide inspired by ICOM’s Object ID categories. These questions do not identify the shop figure.
en.alt: Three questions before the story. Material: What is it made from, and how was it made?. Marks: Is there a signature, stamp or maker’s label?. Date: When was this object made—not just the scene it depicts?.
en.foot: Adapted from ICOM Object ID; not the complete checklist.

sq.title: Tri pyetje para tregimit
sq.subtitle: Një formë e njohur është fillimi i një pyetjeje
items: Nga çfarë është bërë dhe me çfarë teknike?
A ka nënshkrim, vulë apo etiketë të prodhuesit?
Kur është bërë objekti, jo vetëm cilën kohë paraqet?
sq.caption: Udhëzues i shkurtër i frymëzuar nga kategoritë Object ID të ICOM. Këto pyetje nuk e identifikojnë figurën në dyqan.
